continued emphasis on the Corporate segment.
Corporate –Secured: Declined due to repayments and 
account closures, most of which occurred in the first half of 
the year.
Corporate –Unsecured: increased due to new portfolio 
acquisitions by KCCAR , and debtors in this segment have 
continued to make regular payments.
Housing: Decreased following partial repayments and the 
transfer of certain accounts to NPA status.
This year, the company has not acquired additional housing 
portfolios, in line with its strategy to focus on the Corporate 
segment and due to the continued weakness in the housing 
market.(Unit : Million Baht)

Corporate Status Overview
Most of the corporate debtors remain in the Asset Seizure / 
Auction Announcement stage, similar to the position at the 
end of last year. Within this group, approximately 60MB  is 
pending receipt at the Legal Execution Department , which is 
expected to be collected once the transfer and auction 
settlement procedures are completed.
The number of corporate debtors under TDR (Debt 
Restructuring) slightly decreased due to successful account 
closures; however, new restructuring agreements were also 
executed during the period. All debtors in TDR status continue 
to make payments in accordance with the agreed terms, 
reinforcing the stability and visibility of recurring cash inflows 
from this segment.(Unit : Million Baht)

Core collection activities remain solid across both NPL and NPA 
portfolios.
During Q3 2025, KCC collected total cash inflows of 109 MB, 
QoQ decrease was mainly due to the absence of a large 
payment from a major corporate debtor recognized in the 
previous quarter. 
Excluding the one -off effect, underlying collections from TDR 
repayments and regular legal settlements remained healthy, 
indicating the continued ability to generate cash from 
managed portfolios.
Collections from NPA sales increased markedly in Q3 2025 —
particularly from housing assets —following management’s 
strategy to expedite asset disposals to enhance liquidity and 
reduce holding costs.(Unit : Million Baht)
